audit_items.proof_trace: Both layers enforce gas caps but validate DIFFERENT limits: txpool validates tx.GasLimit against blockGasLimit (L21), block validation validates against EIP-7825 per-tx cap (TxValidator.cs:387). Pre-EIP-7825, block validation uses long.MaxValue (no effective cap), but this is by design—transactions exceeding block gas limit would fail during execution without causing consensus issues.
